failure mechanism of SRC plane frames subjected to fire.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the failure mechanism of the steel reinforced concrete plane frames subjected to fire is the combination of failure induced by internal and side columns,which is caused by the axial compression of the heated beams.

the failure mechanism of SRC plane frames subjected to fire could be summarized as follows: the failure of internal columns is the primary factor that causes the failure of the SRC plane frame; the failure of internal and/or side columns is the secondary factor that causes the collapse of the SRC plane framework.
the fire resistance of SRC plane frames is determined by the failure mode and the failure mechanism of the plane frames.

the failure mechanism of SRC plane frames subjected to fire is the combination of the failure modes induced by the internal and side columns.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the failure mode of SRC plane frames can be predicted by the FE model and the failure mechanism of SRC plane frames is that the failure of SRC plane frames starts from the failure of the heated beams,then spreads to the failure of columns,and finally leads to the failure of the whole structure.
the failure of the SRC plane frame subjected to fire is a process of the whole structure failure,which is different from the failure of the steel frame subjected to fire.

the fire resistance of the SRC plane frame is mainly determined by the fire resistance of internal columns and beams,while the side columns have little effect on the fire resistance of SRC plane frames.
